question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Have you ever asked someone to a Sadie Hawkins Dance?
Have you ever had a foreign exchange student?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Sure. Well, I guess it all started last year, when I kissed this girl, Linda, on the Fourth of July...
Twenty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...And then just as I was about to ask $ZOE out, Linda told me she and Kenji had broken up!

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: I see... The classic case of the 'boomerang-ex' versus the 'rookie romance'.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are those translations of French phrases?

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Indeed. When it comes to love, we French have a word for everything.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So... What do I do?

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: I wish I could say... But I can't possibly know until I see you around these girls first.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Tomorrow, we'll begin 'The Ladychooser Gambit!'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is that also a French expression?

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Er. No. I just made that one up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I sure hope Jean Paul actually knows what he's talking about...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess I'm sort of having... Girl trouble.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Fantastique! I am continental Europe's number one expert on the female mind!

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Tell me your troubles... I will sort them out in no time!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... I'm worried about my... Grades.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Unfortunately, grades are not my specialty either.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Back in Marseille, I was so busy picking up girls by the shore, I never had time to study...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great... It turns out that my roommate is a total player... And now he's going to think all I care about is homework!

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: I am an expert in love but little else...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh... Huh. Well, it does so happen that I `also` have a little problem with these two girls.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh... Huh. Well, it does so happen that I [color=#e23b3b][i]also[/i][/color] have a little problem with these two girls.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Two girls, eh? Go on...
Later that night...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What a day... A new roommate... And that's the least of my worries.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What am I supposed to do about $ZOE and Linda?

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: You look upset, Howard. I hope I am not, as you Americans say, 'cramping your style'.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No... No, it's not that.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Howard... We are roommates now! There should be no secrets between us!

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Tell me... What is on your mind?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Jean Paul `is` my roommate... But he's also a total stranger. What should I do?
nodes.text_bbcode: Jean Paul [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] my roommate... But he's also a total stranger. What should I do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The twins made this mess... Let `them` share a room with Jean Paul!
nodes.text_bbcode: The twins made this mess... Let [color=#e23b3b][i]them[/i][/color] share a room with Jean Paul!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Howard! You really want your little sisters to share a room with a teenage stranger?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They love strangers! They're always asking them for candy!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: No one ever has candy.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: I am perfectly comfortable sleeping on the living room couch.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: And risk you drooling on my suede slipcovers?!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Jean Paul isn't sleeping on the couch! Like it or not, Howard, he's sleeping in your room!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey... It's cool. It'll be like practice for having a roommate in college.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Truly you are a generous host, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: And because you are my roommate, let me present you with this gift of Belgian chocolate.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: No fair!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We can't go on just eating American chocolate! We'll die!
Howard munches down on his chocolate bar.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know, Jean Paul, I think this is going to work out just fine.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What a stressful night. But at least there shouldn't be any more unexpected phone calls...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right?
Howard stares at his phone...
...And the doorbell rings!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You've got to be kidding me!
Howard opens the door to his dining room and sees...

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Hello, American brother! It is I, Jean Paul!
Jean Paul pulls Howard in for a massive bear-hug.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Yes. It's nice to meet you too, 'bro'.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now... Who exactly are you?
Howard's mom and dad and his twin sisters Kay and Kel join him at the door.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: What's going on here?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Is he selling vacuum cleaners?! Knives? Vacuum cleaners with knife attachments?! Let me at him, honey!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: He's not selling vacuums!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: He's Jean Paul!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait a second... You know this guy?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Dad wouldn't make us French toast...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: So we signed us up for a French foreign exchange student!

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: I'm actually half-French, half-Italian...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Ooo... Italian Toast!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: There will be no toast in this house but good old-fashioned, slightly-burnt American toast!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Dear... You're scaring our guest.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Why don't you come in, Jean Paul?
Everyone sits down around the dinner table.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Well, we may not have known you were coming, Jean Paul, but we're certainly glad to have you.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Quite frankly, I've been worried about Howard's 'America-first' attitude.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa! I let the twins ruin `one` British tea party by throwing their supplies in the harbor, and suddenly `I'm` the bad guy!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! I let the twins ruin [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] British tea party by throwing their supplies in the harbor, and suddenly [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] the bad guy!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I guess the only question is where you should stay...
Everyone looks in Howard's direction.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait... Not... `My` room?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... Not... [color=#e23b3b][i]My[/i][/color] room?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Honestly... I'm having a hard time choosing between you and $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But... How can that even be a choice?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You `know` how you feel about me, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] how you feel about me, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Er... I have to go... Help my little sisters find a lost kitten!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Bye!
Howard hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay. I `definitely` need to figure out my girl situation, ASAP.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay. I [color=#e23b3b][i]definitely[/i][/color] need to figure out my girl situation, ASAP.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Honestly... I haven't even been thinking about the dance.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess I've just been so busy thinking about... Global warming!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Huh... I never knew you were such an environmentalist.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh yeah. I'm `huge` into that stuff. You know. Carbon caps. Ice caps. Polar bears.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah. I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]huge[/i][/color] into that stuff. You know. Carbon caps. Ice caps. Polar bears.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hm... Maybe I've been a little too obsessed with this dance.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I guess there are more important things going on in the world.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But try to give me an answer in the next couple of days, okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Definitely.
Linda hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can't believe that actually worked!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, at least that's over with. Now I can just take a second to...

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Ring, ring...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you kidding me?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh whoa! It's Linda!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, Howard... I'm just finishing up softball practice...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And the whole time I was here, people kept asking me who I'm going to ask to the Sadie Hawkins Dance.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But there's only really one person I want to go with.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So... Do you want to go to the Sadie Hawkins Dance with me?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great! What am I supposed to tell her?

nodes.prompt: What am I supposed to tell her?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What am I supposed to tell her?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... That doesn't exactly sound urgent.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're not just avoiding me, are you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No... No way! I'm just not sure if I can dance... Because I have... Warts? Uh, yeah. Warts! All over my feet! Dancing hurts!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But then how do you play football?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Custom cleats?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just... Let me know when you've made a decision, okay?
$ZOE hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Somehow, I think that could have gone better.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... That doesn't exactly sound urgent.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're not just avoiding me, are you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No... No way! I'm just not sure if I can dance... Because I have... Warts? Uh, yeah. Warts! All over my feet! Dancing hurts!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But then how do you play football?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Custom cleats?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just... Let me know when you've made a decision, okay?
$ZOE hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Somehow, I think that could have gone better.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well... I guess that is kind of urgent.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But please let me know soon... Taylor says she's going to make girls without dance-dates be on the bottom of the pyramid.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure thing. I'll let you know right away.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Phew. That was close.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... That doesn't exactly sound urgent.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're not just avoiding me, are you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No... No way! I'm just not sure if I can dance... Because I have... Warts? Uh, yeah. Warts! All over my feet! Dancing hurts!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But then how do you play football?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Custom cleats?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just... Let me know when you've made a decision, okay?
$ZOE hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Somehow, I think that could have gone better.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Talking about me? Only good things, I hope.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Naturally.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was just hearing the story about the time your little sisters attacked everyone with 'mistle-`toads`' at a holiday party.
nodes.text_bbcode: I was just hearing the story about the time your little sisters attacked everyone with 'mistle-[color=#3b78e2][i]toads[/i][/color]' at a holiday party.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh yeah! Heh. That was pretty funny.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aw... I want to meet your little sisters!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hehe. That's what you say `now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hehe. That's what you say [color=#3b78e2][i]now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nice! It looks like I'm scoring points with both of the girls.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: I may spend a moment in the men's room and then return.
Jean Paul stares meaningfully at Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Go ahead. You can handle everything yourself, right?
Jean Paul leans in and whispers in Howard's ear.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: We must plot our next course of action! Now, accompany me to the commode!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Er... Sorry, girls. But I also... Have to go. Like, a lot. I have to go a lot.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Just 'excuse me' would probably have been enough.
Thirty seconds later...

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: So... How's it going? It looks like you chose the girl you want.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I'm not sure!

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: It's time to be a man and make a decision!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... But I'm not `sure!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But... But I'm not [color=#e23b3b][i]sure![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Mark my words, Howard...

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: If you don't choose one of these girls by the end of the dance, you'll lose both of them.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Easier said than done...
Later, at the dance...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Cool... Hector's doing a great job as DJ!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: As long as he keeps playing fast songs like this, we can all dance in a group!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, hey! Glad you guys are here!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: We hope the dance meets or exceeds all your expectations!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah! I love the decorations! This is `way` better than the Winter Dance!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! I love the decorations! This is [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] better than the Winter Dance!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's just hope you don't have a snow machine ready to go this time!
Scott looks behind his shoulder at the stage.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I... Er... I mean...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hehe. Just kidding. I learned my lesson.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Scott spent the budget on balloons, punch, and a live band for later!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... Wait. Isn't Hector DJing all night?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No, man. He's just the opening act! We're about to slow things down with 'Softrox'! They're a ballads-only cover band!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I know I'm planning to slow-dance with Angie for the rest of the night... You should grab your special lady and get ready to do the same!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This definitely isn't good.

nodes.speaker: Singer
nodes.text: Hey there, Centerscore High! It's time to dance to some soft-rock tunes! Let's start this off with 'You're the Only One for Me, Forever'.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You should go ahead and order, Jean Paul. I'm sure you know what's best.
The waiter returns. He and Jean Paul talk in rapid-fire French for a few minutes and then embrace!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: The waiter is my step-brother's natural father's adopted cousin!

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: He says he'll bring us the finest food they have to offer... At half-price!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sounds good to me!
And a few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow! This is the best thing I've ever tasted!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I know! What is this?

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Er... It's probably best you don't know! But it sure does taste good, no?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nice! The girls seem like they're having a great time!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's just hope that trend continues...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, Jean Paul! This is the 21st century! The girls can order for themselves.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I... I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hm... Maybe I should just point randomly at the menu and order whatever my finger touches?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great idea! We'll all be surprised!
Everyone places their orders, and a few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What... What is this?

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: I can't even believe they serve `that` here! It's illegal in France...
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't even believe they serve [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] here! It's illegal in France...

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: I mean... It's a humiliation for the poor pig, you know?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ew, ew, ew...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I'm enjoying my soup!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well good for you...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great... Things are getting tense between the girls. I knew this 'double date' was a bad idea!
A while later the waiter comes by and passes out menus.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huh... I sort of don't know what any of the words on this menu mean. Is the 'l'eau' good?

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: That's 'water'.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Er... What I mean is, maybe I should order for all of us?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is that really a good idea? What if he orders something the girls don't like?

nodes.prompt: What if he orders something the girls don't like?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What if he orders something the girls don't like?

nodes.text: Howard sits next to $ZOE, and Jean Paul sits next to Linda.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Oh dear... I hate to see such a lovely face twisted in such a malevolent manner.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Come, Linda... Howard tells me you are a softball player. Perhaps you can explain the rules?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nice wing-work, Jean Paul! Now I can concentrate on $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So, $ZOE... How's cheerleading been treating you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not bad... Sam and I have been working on this new routine where we both do backflips and land in the splits!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I would... Like to see that sometime.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I `bet` you would.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]bet[/i][/color] you would.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm really glad that Sam and I are friends now...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Life just feels a lot better without her hating me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But there's still one thing that could make my life even better.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's that?
$ZOE squeezes Howard's hand.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know you and Linda have a lot of history...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I feel like we've really connected.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I don't know how you feel... I've never had a boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I can't help but feel like we'd be really great together.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Man... $ZOE is so cute and fun...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But can I really choose her over Linda?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This decision isn't getting any easier...
Howard sits next to Linda, and Jean Paul sits next to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: My dear $ZOE, Howard mentioned that you've recently become a 'cheerleader'. Perhaps you can explain to me what that is?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There are no cheerleaders in France?

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: We're an individualistic people and cheer when we deem it appropriate. Our cheers need not be 'led'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, let me explain how it works over here!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nice going, Jean Paul! Now I can talk with Linda without feeling bad about $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So, Linda... It's been a while since we really talked... I mean, how was your summer?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Are you sure you really want to hear about my summer? I spent a lot of it with Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I admit, I'm not `thrilled` to hear more about Kenji...
nodes.text_bbcode: I admit, I'm not [color=#e23b3b][i]thrilled[/i][/color] to hear more about Kenji...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I'd hate for there to a part of you I'm missing out on, just because I feel a little jealous.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There was a time when I felt like I `really` knew you. I want to get back to that.
nodes.text_bbcode: There was a time when I felt like I [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] knew you. I want to get back to that.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Aw... That's really sweet, Howard. Okay... Let's see. Where do I start?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What... What are you saying about me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We were just saying how funny it is that your lower lip always trembles when you're nervous.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No it doesn't!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hehe. It just did!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay... That's just embarrassing.
The next day, in the cafeteria...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ah, my first day at an American cafeteria. I love it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The happy students, the beautiful girls, the immodest clothing...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But... What is that stench?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That would be the cafeteria food.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And yet somehow your countrymen lead the world in obesity?

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Oh well... At least the girls are 'tasty'.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Now... Show me the two mistresses with whom you have become entangled.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay... Well... Let's see. Where are they?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh no! They're... They're talking to each other! Right over there!

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: A classic case of 'The Collapsing Triangle'! We must move quickly.
Jean Paul grabs Howard's arm and drags him across the cafeteria to where Linda and $ZOE are talking.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We were just talking about you.
Jean Paul bends over and whispers in Howard's ear.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: They're testing you, Howard! A classic 'Double Medusa Exam'! Don't let them see you sweat!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Easy for him to say! Okay, Howard... Just be cool.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoa! With moves like that, you could be on the cheerleading team!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh. Well, if this football thing doesn't work out, I'll think about it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well... Let's see if you can do `this` move!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... Let's see if you can do [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] move!

nodes.text: $ZOE does a backflip, then lands on one hand and holds her body completely still.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Nice moves, you two!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hehe. You're like the hottest couple on the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess we make a pretty good pair.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aw... I get a big smile on my face every time I hang out with $ZOE.
Howard does an amazing headspin!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There you are!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm so glad you're back!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Girls... I think I've made my choice.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh, no offense, but who cares about `your` choice?
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, no offense, but who cares about [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] choice?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... We want to find out who Jean Paul is `really` after!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... We want to find out who Jean Paul is [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] after!

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Now, now, ladies... There's plenty of Jean Paul to go around.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I thought... I mean didn't you... Jean Paul?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sorry, Howard... But we were talking while you were in the bathroom...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And we're both tired of you being so indecisive.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Plus, European guys are just way cuter than American ones.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's true... We can't help being attracted to European men. It's just simple science!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How is that `science?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: How is that [color=#e23b3b][i]science?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: I am sorry, Howard. I simply have this effect on women. I cannot help it.
Suddenly, there's a commotion as a police officer enters the dance, trailed by Kay and Kel!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: That's him, officer!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: The ugly one with the black hair!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you talking about me?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Easy there, Frenchy. Don't make this hard on yourself. Unlike where you come from, we believe in corporal punishment here!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And we `don't` take kindly to kids who make spelling errors on their student visas! That's a federal offense!
nodes.text_bbcode: And we [color=#e23b3b][i]don't[/i][/color] take kindly to kids who make spelling errors on their student visas! That's a federal offense!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait... You've got the wrong guy! I'm Howard! I'm an American!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Sure you are, Jean Paul. You're going right back to France where you belong!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait... No... I'm not Jean Paul!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yes you are!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Bye bye, Howa... I mean, Jean Paul!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah... Have fun back in France!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't worry! We'll take good care of 'Howard' here while you're away!

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Yes... I'm sure you will, my little croissant!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You've got to be kidding me.
Three days later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hola! Me llamo Howard! Soy de Estados Unidos!

nodes.speaker: French Guy
nodes.text: Je ne parle pas espagnol.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I knew I should have taken French instead of Spanish...
Well, that's that.
It sure didn't take you long to ruin Howard's life and have him deported.
Now we're just guessing here, but we `think` you might be able to earn a better ending.
nodes.text_bbcode: Now we're just guessing here, but we [b]think[/b] you might be able to earn a better ending.

nodes.text: What do you say? Are you ready to give it another try?

nodes.text: Howard and Jean Paul return to the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How could I have been so stupid?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I should have gone with $ZOE in the first place!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I should have gone with Linda in the first place!

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: I... I don't know what to say.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Perhaps seeing me with her helped you realize what you truly want.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What a mess... How am I ever going to explain myself now?

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: I'm sure you'll figure something out...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I'm sorry, Jean Paul.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If you like $ZOE... You should just go for her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I won't stand in your way.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If you like Linda... You should just go for her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I won't stand in your way.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are... Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was going to do... A headspin.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... If you're going to do that, you really want to start from a kneeling position, then start your rotational force earlier.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like this!
$ZOE does an awesome headspin.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great... As if I didn't look bad enough already, now $ZOE is totally showing me up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe we don't make that good of a couple...
Howard jumps up and lands on his head! There's a horrible cracking sound!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ow... Ow... Ow...
Jean Paul does a spin, pulls a rose out of his back pocket, and puts it in his teeth.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What the...?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So that's how it is, huh?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well it just so happens I've got a few dance moves of my own!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We can take a break from slow-dancing for a minute or two...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right now, it's time to shake what my momma gave me and give the girls a little show!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's see if I can pull off that headspin move from last week's episode of 'Armenia's Best Dance Team'!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Linda... May I have this dance?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You bet.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: My dear $ZOE... Though I am perhaps not the date you first desired, I would be honored if you'd dance with me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aw... Well, when you put it that way.
Jean Paul and $ZOE begin slow dancing, staring deep into each others' eyes.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Jean Paul is a good wing-man... But does he really have to stare at $ZOE like that?
Jean Paul leans over and nibbles delicately on $ZOE's ear!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hehe. You're kind of fun, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... Why are you staring at them?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Er... Never mind. I only have eyes for you, sweetie.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's better. Now come here and dance with me!
Linda holds Howard close as they start dancing.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Aw... This reminds me of that one time we danced at 'Charma'.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait a second... I've never been to 'Charma'.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Eep! Er... I must have meant... Something else?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is she getting me confused with Kenji?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I'm starting to think I made a mistake!
Howard looks across the dance floor at $ZOE and Jean Paul.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE... May I have this dance?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You bet.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: My dear Linda... Though I am perhaps not the date you first desired, I would be honored if you'd dance with me.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Aw... Well, when you put it that way.
Jean Paul and Linda begin slow dancing, staring deep into each others' eyes.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Jean Paul is a good wing-man... But does he really have to stare at Linda like that?
Jean Paul leans over and nibbles delicately on Linda's ear!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hehe. You're kind of fun, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Why are you staring at them?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Er... Never mind. I only have eyes for you, sweetie.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's better. Now come here and dance with me!
$ZOE pulls Howard close, and they start to dance together.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey... Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... It's just... No one's ever asked me to a dance before.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?! A pretty girl like you?! I bet a lot of guys wanted to ask you... They were probably just too intimidated.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aw... Howard. You're really sweet.
$ZOE leans in and kisses Howard on the cheek.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow... Dancing like this with $ZOE is almost enough to make me forget all about Linda...
Howard looks across the dance floor at Jean Paul and Linda.
The band begins to play...
$ZOE and Linda both look expectantly at Howard.

nodes.prompt: $ZOE and Linda both look expectantly at Howard.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: $ZOE and Linda both look expectantly at Howard.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Heh-hem.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh... I almost forgot. $ZOE and Linda, meet Jean Paul. Jean Paul, meet Linda and $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Nice to meet you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: The pleasure is mine.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: In fact, Howard and I have been talking... And we'd like you to be our dates to the Sadie Hawkins Dance this Friday.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We... We would?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But wait... Who's going with who?

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Such distinctions are unimportant!

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: What matters is that we all go together and have fun!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Count me in!

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Fantastique! Then we shall see you both soon.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm kind of getting a bad feeling about this.
And so... That Friday.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh wow... This place is nice!

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: But of course! It's a French restaurant. How could it not be?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Since when did you get so fancy, Howard? Didn't you take me to the Burger Shack before the dance last year?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That was charming!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, I guess you weren't trying so hard to impress `me...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I guess you weren't trying so hard to impress [color=#3b78e2][i]me...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Linda glares at $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I `really` hope bringing both girls here wasn't a mistake.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] hope bringing both girls here wasn't a mistake.

nodes.text: A waiter guides the four of them to a table near the back. The girls sit down.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay... Moment of truth, Howard. Who do you want to sit next to?

nodes.prompt: Who do I want to sit next to?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Who do I want to sit next to?

nodes.text: Just then, Howard looks across the room to see Jean Paul dipping $ZOE low to the ground.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not cool! It's time for me and Jean Paul to have a little talk!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... Howard? Where are you going?
Linda follows Howard as he walks over to Jean Paul and $ZOE.
Just then, Howard looks across the room to see Jean Paul dipping Linda low to the ground.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not cool! It's time for me and Jean Paul to have a little talk!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Howard? Where are you going?
$ZOE follows Howard as he walks over to Jean Paul and Linda.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Jean Paul, I think you and I need to make another trip to the bathroom.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: We do?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But you just went to the bathroom back at the restaurant...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We have really fast metabolisms!
Thirty seconds later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you think you're trying to pull out there?

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: But... But you made your choice. I was just having a little fun.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're supposed to be helping me, not trying to steal my girl!

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: I didn't think you'd be so jealous.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... If I'm jealous... What does that mean?!

nodes.prompt: If I'm jealous... What does that mean?!

options.label: It's just hard to let go.

nodes.title: Foreign Exchange
nodes.subtitle: A new friend for Howard... And a new girlfriend too?

nodes.text: A few weeks after the events of 'The New Girl'...
It's a quiet Thursday night at Howard's house... Until the silence is interrupted by...

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Ring, ring...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm, uh, just kind of wondering if you have any plans for Friday?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know, like, for the `Sadie Hawkin's Dance.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You know, like, for the [color=#3b78e2][i]Sadie Hawkin's Dance.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh man... I totally forgot that was coming up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I `do` want to go to the dance...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] want to go to the dance...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I still don't know if I want to go with `$ZOE` or with `Linda!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But I still don't know if I want to go with [color=#e23b3b][i]$ZOE[/i][/color] or with [color=#e23b3b][i]Linda![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Panic mode... I need to say something to buy myself some time!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh shoot. Uh. I need to go...

nodes.speaker: Howard

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh shoot. Uh. I need to go...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Whoa! Where were those moves last year?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh. I spent a lot of the summer in my room watching dance videos on the internet.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hehe. Even after all this time, you can still surprise me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Huh... Maybe Linda and I really `can` make a fresh start!
nodes.text_bbcode: Huh... Maybe Linda and I really [color=#e23b3b][i]can[/i][/color] make a fresh start!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Girls... I've been doing some thinking...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I've decided that I choose...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE! I mean Linda... I mean $ZOE. I mean...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay, that's it. I'm done here.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm with you, Linda.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: If you really cared about `either` of us, you would have made a choice by now.
nodes.text_bbcode: If you really cared about [color=#3b78e2][i]either[/i][/color] of us, you would have made a choice by now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But you only really care about one person... Yourself.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Goodbye, Howard.
The girls walks away.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: I am sorry, Howard...

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: But in France, we have a way of cheering up a man who has been left by his lovers.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You... You do?
And so, an hour later...

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: More French toast anyone?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No thanks, I'm stuffed.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: More for me!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Explain to me again how this is supposed to cheer me up.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Simple! No one can possibly be sad while they're eating French toast!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: More, more, more!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, at least the twins are happy...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But this really wasn't the way I'd hoped to end my night...
Sometimes in life you have to make a decision...
And in this case, all of Howard's waffling has led to nothing but French toast!
Give this another shot... And this time help Howard make up his mind!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Girls... There's something I need to say.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sorry for dragging you both on this ridiculous double date.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I should have just made up my mind in the first place.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, you're a great girl...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I love Linda. I always have.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Aw... Howard.
Linda hugs Howard and gives him a kiss.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I understand.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I want you to be happy, Howard... And it looks like you are.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I'll see you around.
$ZOE walks off into the distance.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Perhaps I should go... Console her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm so glad we can finally be together!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You have no idea how terrified I was that I was really going to lose you.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Now, come here and give me another kiss.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Mmm... Linda...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Mmm... Kenji...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: KENJI?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Er... Oops...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You still aren't over him?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sorry... I've always had a hard time picking between the two of you! You know that!
In the distance, Howard sees $ZOE crying in Jean Paul's arms.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think I may have just made a terrible mistake.
Sometimes it's just time to break with the past.
Linda clearly can't get over Kenji... So maybe it's time to give Howard a fresh start!
Want to play one more time and see if Howard can win $ZOE's heart?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Girls... There's something I need to say.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sorry for dragging you both on this ridiculous double date.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I should have just made up my mind in the first place.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Linda, you're a great girl, and we've been through a lot together...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I think we both deserve a fresh start.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: With $ZOE, I have a chance to start with a blank slate... To not make the same mistakes I made with you.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I... I understand.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: This whole last year, I've been doing the same thing, going back and forth between liking you and Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And honestly... It's exhausting.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I think maybe... Maybe I just need a break from guys for a little while.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: How... Unfortunate.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Heh. Well, I wouldn't say 'no' to a dance with a handsome Frenchman.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: That's more like it. After you, my dear.
Jean Paul and Linda walk to the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE... I'm sorry I waited this long to ask you...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But will you be my date to the dance? My one and only date?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: As long as you promise never to pull this kind of thing again.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I promise!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, okay then.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... I think this is the part where you lean in and kiss me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, right!
Howard pulls $ZOE close.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's a new beginning for both of us...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And there's no one else I'd rather share it with.
Aw... Well... That's just... Really... Sniff...
See what you did! You made us cry!
Anyway, we should give these two some privacy!
You've done an awesome job helping Howard and $ZOE finally get together!
We hope you've enjoyed this episode of 'Surviving High School'!

nodes.text: Tell me about it...
